description: This source file defines the 'MutableMessageSource' interface, which extends message source capabilities in the OpenMRS framework by allowing retrieval, addition, removal, and merging of presentation messages, as well as access to message locales and collections.

classes.name: MutableMessageSource
classes.description: An interface extending MessageSource and HierarchicalMessageSource to provide mutability and additional message management capabilities.

methods.name: getLocales
methods.description: Returns the collection of locales for which messages are available.

methods.name: getPresentations
methods.description: Returns all presentation messages available in the source.

methods.name: getPresentationsInLocale
methods.description: Returns presentation messages available for a specific locale.

methods.name: addPresentation
methods.description: Adds a presentation message, overwriting existing if conflicts occur.

methods.name: getPresentation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific presentation message for a given key and locale.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges messages from another MutableMessageSource, with optional overwrite.
